ModMetaData.name: Ideology Delete UI 1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a delete button to every ideoligion row in the in-game Ideology screen and adds a developer action: Ideoligion -> Delete ideoligion....
Deletion is deliberately safe: it is blocked while any faction still uses the ideoligion or any pawn currently believes in it. If no live references remain, the mod calls RimWorld's own IdeoManager.Remove() and cleans baby ideology exposure references.
